title: Starting music at twelve and early teachers
summary: Sid began around 1928, absorbing New Orleans jazz, then studied saxophone and clarinet with Jean Parquet and Tony Parenti.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: It's difficult to say. We were always surrounded by jazz in New Orleans and I guess we kind of grew up with that, you know, the flavor and smell of jazz around us.

But I remember that, you know, the music that you had heard at that age, you know, the music that you had heard at that age. And I remember getting a saxophone in the clarinet and studying with Jean Parquet and Tony Parenti when I was a kid. And by George, that was about the only thing for me to do.
